import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long P = 1000000007;

    static class FiniteField {
        long x;
        FiniteField(long x) {
            if (x > P || x < 0) {
                throw new RuntimeException("Invalid FiniteField!");
            }
            this.x = x;
        }
        FiniteField() {
            this.x = 0;
        }
        long value() {
            return x;
        }
        FiniteField add(FiniteField o) {
            return new FiniteField((x + o.x) % P);
        }
        FiniteField subtract(FiniteField o) {
            return new FiniteField((x - o.x + P) % P);
        }
        FiniteField multiply(FiniteField o) {
            return new FiniteField((x * o.x) % P);
        }
        FiniteField divide(FiniteField o) {
            return new FiniteField((x * modInverse(o.x, P)) % P);
        }
        private long modInverse(long a, long m) {
            long m0 = m, t, q;
            long x0 = 0, x1 = 1;
            if (m == 1) return 0;
            while (a > 1) {
                q = a / m;
                t = m;
                m = a % m; a = t;
                t = x0;
                x0 = x1 - q * x0;
                x1 = t;
            }
            if (x1 < 0) x1 += m0;
            return x1;
        }
    }

    public static <T> List<List<T>> make2DVector(int d1, int d2, T defaultValue) {
        List<List<T>> v = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < d1; i++) {
            List<T> row = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(d2, defaultValue));
            v.add(row);
        }
        return v;
    }

    public static <T> List<List<List<T>>> make3DVector(int d1, int d2, int d3, T defaultValue) {
        List<List<List<T>>> v = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < d1; i++) {
            v.add(make2DVector(d2, d3, defaultValue));
        }
        return v;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        int d = sc.nextInt();

        List<List<List<FiniteField>>> shifts = make3DVector(d, d + 1, d + 1, new FiniteField(0));
        for (int k = 0; k < d; k++) {
            for (int i = 0; i < d; i++) {
                shifts.get(k).get(i).set((i + k) % d, new FiniteField(1));
            }
            shifts.get(k).get(d).set(d, new FiniteField(1));
        }

        List<List<List<FiniteField>>> units = make3DVector(d, d + 1, d + 1, new FiniteField(0));
        for (int k = 0; k < d; k++) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= d; i++) {
                units.get(k).get(i).set(i, new FiniteField(1));
            }
            for (int i = 0; i <= d; i++) {
                units.get(k).get(k).set(i, new FiniteField(1));
            }
        }

        List<List<FiniteField>> identity = make2DVector(d + 1, d + 1, new FiniteField(0));
        for (int i = 0; i <= d; i++) {
            identity.get(i).set(i, new FiniteField(1));
        }

        Map<Long, List<List<FiniteField>>> cache = new HashMap<>();

        Function<Long, List<List<FiniteField>>> findMatrix = new java.util.function.Function<Long, List<List<FiniteField>>>() {
            public List<List<FiniteField>> apply(Long p) {
                if (cache.containsKey(p)) {
                    return cache.get(p);
                }

                List<List<FiniteField>> result;
                if (p <= d) {
                    result = copyMatrix(identity);
                    for (int k = 0; k < p; k++) {
                        result = multiplyMatrices(units.get(k), result);
                    }
                    cache.put(p, result);
                    return result;
                }

                long child_p = d;
                while ((p + child_p - 1) / child_p > d) {
                    child_p *= d;
                }
                List<List<FiniteField>> child = apply(child_p);
                List<List<FiniteField>> matrix = copyMatrix(child);
                long remaining_p = p - child_p;
                for (int k = 1; k < d; k++) {
                    if (remaining_p >= child_p) {
                        matrix = multiplyMatrices(shifts.get(d - k), multiplyMatrices(child, multiplyMatrices(shifts.get(k), matrix)));
                        remaining_p -= child_p;
                    } else if (remaining_p > 0) {
                        matrix = multiplyMatrices(shifts.get(d - k), multiplyMatrices(apply(remaining_p), multiplyMatrices(shifts.get(k), matrix)));
                        remaining_p = 0;
                    } else {
                        break;
                    }
                }

                cache.put(p, matrix);
                return matrix;
            }
        };

        List<List<FiniteField>> matrix = findMatrix.apply(n);
        List<FiniteField> baseVector = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(d + 1, new FiniteField(0)));
        baseVector.set(d, new FiniteField(1));
        List<FiniteField> finalVector = multiplyMatrixVector(matrix, baseVector);

        FiniteField ans = new FiniteField(0);
        for (FiniteField x : finalVector) {
            ans = ans.add(x);
        }
        System.out.println(ans.value());
    }

    static List<List<FiniteField>> copyMatrix(List<List<FiniteField>> matrix) {
        List<List<FiniteField>> copy = new ArrayList<>();
        for (List<FiniteField> row : matrix) {
            copy.add(new ArrayList<>(row));
        }
        return copy;
    }

    static List<List<FiniteField>> multiplyMatrices(List<List<FiniteField>> a, List<List<FiniteField>> b) {
        int n = a.size();
        int m = a.get(0).size();
        int l = b.get(0).size();
        List<List<FiniteField>> result = make2DVector(n, l, new FiniteField(0));
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < l; j++) {
                FiniteField sum = new FiniteField(0);
                for (int k = 0; k < m; k++) {
                    sum = sum.add(a.get(i).get(k).multiply(b.get(k).get(j)));
                }
                result.get(i).set(j, sum);
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

    static List<FiniteField> multiplyMatrixVector(List<List<FiniteField>> matrix, List<FiniteField> vector) {
        int n = matrix.size();
        int m = matrix.get(0).size();
        List<FiniteField> result = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(n, new FiniteField(0)));
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            FiniteField sum = new FiniteField(0);
            for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                sum = sum.add(matrix.get(i).get(j).multiply(vector.get(j)));
            }
            result.set(i, sum);
        }
        return result;
    }
}
